        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .module_voltage }"

          sensor: pon
      - name: pon_optic_temp_celsius
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .optic_tempC }"

        labels:
          sensor: pon
      - name: pon_ploam_state
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .ploam_state }"

        labels:
          sensor: pon
      - name: pon_rx_power_dbm
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .rx_power_dBm }"
